kind_of_no: annual-lease campground; the resort's only nightly RV site is US$65 by inquiry, over the gate with no gateway
why: Google Maps 'Cabana Shores Campground' (46039 238th St, Wentworth SD 57075; 5.0/6, phone 605-929-5507, gm.py read 2026-11-22) links hillsideresort.com/lakeshore-campground.html. That page (Wayback captures 2018-05-03 through 2025-10-09, all the same) is titled 'CabanaShores Campground' and offers 'Annual Leased Camp Spots', '1100' of Sandy Beach on Long Lake', 'Electric / Water / Sewer Available', 'Please call (605) 256-9558 with questions and availability' - no nightly rate. The URL now redirects to The Hillside Resort's /cabins page (read 2026-11-22), which lists '1 RV Site · from $65': a 'Full-Hookup RV Site', 30/50 amp, 'From $65 / night', 'Inquiry only · 2026 season' via a request form. Fails long-stay test 3 (annual lease) and has no price indicator for the leased campground; the resort's single nightly RV site is $65, over the US$50 gate, with no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: none; nearest Minneapolis 319 km) and no Good Sam listing (directory cache has no Cabana/Hillside park).
name: Cabana Shores Campground (The Hillside Resort, Lake Madison)
flags: Cabana Shores is The Hillside Resort's own leased campground, across 238th St from the resort at 46042 238th St (Lake Madison / Long Lake isthmus, Wentworth). Google's 605-929-5507 is the resort's Sea Store number on hillsideresort.com.

Esri World Imagery crop (sat.py, 900 m frame, rendered, 2026-11-22) at the Google point: about 40-50 RVs in tight parallel rows on a sandy point south of the resort buildings, between Lake Madison's south bay and Long Lake - the look of a seasonal park like Dirks, Basler and Jacobs Landing (leads 25-27). Waterfront not audited (skipped).

The resort's one nightly 'Full-Hookup RV Site' (from $65, inquiry-only for 2026; the FAQ sets a minimum 'on summer weekends (Fri-Sun). One night otherwise. Three-night minimum on Memorial Day, July 4th, and Labor Day weekends') could be a separate, single-site candidate, but it fails the price gate on its own and is a single site.
Not a duplicate: no Cabana or Hillside entry in campgrounds.json; the nearest entry is 5736 Walker's Point RA, about 2.7 km NW.

If AWH wants it reconsidered, the only route is a phone call to (605) 256-9558 or (605) 838-7953 to ask whether any Cabana Shores spots are sold by the night and at what rate. Not attempted (no calls).
